name: @siku/ui
description: Design system SIKU : tokens, composants Svelte 5, styles, polices, runtime NUI et outils, pour les interfaces FiveM et les applications web.

scripts.build: bun run tokens && svelte-package -i src/lib -o dist && bun run ai && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/.version', require('./package.json').version)"
scripts.check: bun run tokens && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && node bin/siku.mjs check src/lib docs/src --self
scripts.docs:build: vite build --config docs/vite.config.ts && vite build --config docs/vite.embed.config.ts
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run docs:build && node scripts/verify-fixture.mjs
